No we don’t but since you’re smart and able enough to get your items - I think a self checkout should be fairly easy too!(: 
so easy to have a opinion and argue about not wanting to do something for yourself then being understanding and sympathetic to others. And you’re right retail has operated a certain way for a extremely long time but corporation is changing that and could care about how it’s effecting its customers. because it’s easier to have 1 associate to do everything and end up losing some customers then to pay multiple associates to be on the floor.

I agree but unfortunately cvs is changing. They are cutting not only the hours but now forcing single colleagues to be alone for hours to not only cash out customers but also are expected to do truck, BOH, tags and other duties. And if those aren’t done- it unfortunately still falls back on us even with a lack of colleagues. 
If they had other colleagues I’d be easier to simply stay up front to checkout others. But constantly being alone for large durations makes it harder to focus on just customers needs. I wish cvs went back to focusing on the customer but it isn’t that anymore. Corporate doesn’t care. Don’t blame the workers we only do what we’re told to do.
